name: Gizen
source:
A new health teacher turns out to be hypocrite who catches and abuses students.

The school confines female students it likes to the toilet and allows them to live there without any worries.

from HINT.TXT

新來的保健教師原來是個偽善者，他抓住學生後肆意虐待。

學校將自己看中的女學生關進廁所，任由她們在那裡「生活」，彷彿一切都無所謂。
